name: Forward Ammunition Point

placement_rationale.text: 6 km places this at the built-up block Pass 17 sited on this side of the strip — real standing ground with the kind of road access and structures a forward ammunition point would actually use, rather than open steppe. No committed OSM rail data exists on this side (the Pass 17 inset is anchored side_a-only, per docs/BACKLOG.md), so a built-up-block proxy is the honest, closest-available siting rather than inventing a second, independent rail claim this map cannot back with real geometry.

employment_notes: Represents a forward ammunition point rather than a specific named facility, sited on real standing terrain (a built-up block) rather than an arbitrary coordinate.
contrast_vs_traditional: Traditional logistics could stage ammunition dumps relatively close to the line under the protection of distance and counter-battery limits. Persistent drone ISR pushes bulk storage back and forces the last-mile leg onto vehicles — increasingly unmanned — making short, fast runs rather than a standing supply column.
